summary: Mixed library with an angled photo head, a feed of blog, infographic and whitepaper rows beside a Related contents list, and two horizontal rows of cover cards. Needs several content types, each with a label.

sections.note: white ground: orange small caps label, big H1 and a paragraph left; photo right cut with a diagonal edge

rows with a thumbnail left, an orange type label (Blog, Infographic, Whitepaper), an uppercase title cut to two lines, an excerpt and Read more or Download Now; right column Related contents with four titles with author and read time; a numbered pager (1, 2, 3, ..., 16 and an arrow) under the feed
sand ground: centered label and one line; a carousel of four visible video cards (thumbnail slot, uppercase title, small watch time) with four dots under it
grey ground: centered label and one line; a carousel of four visible infographic cards (cover image, white title box) with four dots
